items.title: Jack Kerrigan Interview, 1958-05-04
items.q: I know one man... past... Chris Jan... I... can't remember his name... uh... he got some of his old cronies... to come over from New Orleans

ctx.x: well... when they first started... having it... the Pest... was getting up...

again? when it was reorganized... back in 1947... they started off having... the Puppets... outside... we started off having... what jazz bands... we could... secure on... the Mississippi Gulf Coast... and later on... as the club grew... and got larger space... we... were able to obtain the... uh... jazz band... known as... Celestans... were the actual... Gulf Coast jazz bands... then? they were... Gulf Coast jazz bands... there was one located... in Bay St. Louis... I don't recall the name... there was one…
